endpoints.logic: Verifies credentials using Bcrypt, returns JWT + Profile payload.
Registers new staff (coordinator/admin). Validates requester role.
Bootstraps first super_admin if collection is empty. Requires secret_key.
Adds new route. Validates stop array and fare types.
Fetches all active routes from DB.
Removes route. Logs action in Audit Trail.
Multipart upload. Saves image to S3 folder /doctor_logos/.
Schedules camp. Uploads banner to S3 folder /blood_camps/.
Fetches chronological logs of all destructive actions.

rbac_hierarchy.super_admin: Global Bypass. Root access to system settings and all user permissions.
rbac_hierarchy.admin: Delegated Authority. Can manage other Admins, Coordinators, and Members. Cannot edit self-permission.
rbac_hierarchy.coordinator: Operational. Can manage resources (Bus, Events, etc.) but restricted from Users and Settings.
rbac_hierarchy.member: Standard User. Read-only access to internal platform data.

ci_cd_devops.pipeline: GitHub Actions (Continuous Integration & Cloud Formation Deployment)
